Container.Name: shrinkarr
Container.Overview:
Shrinks your video library: re-encodes to HEVC/AV1 with your GPU at a quality you can't tell apart, with a visual flow editor and ready-made templates. Open the web UI and follow the setup wizard.
NVIDIA: install the Nvidia Driver plugin, then add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Intel / AMD: Add another Path, Port, Variable, Label or Device → Device → /dev/dri.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your movies and TV folder. Shrinkarr replaces files here, so it needs read/write.

Config.Name: Temp
Config.Description: Scratch space for quality test samples

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: 'all' or your GPU UUID. Needs --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: SHRINKARR_DISABLE_AUTH
Config.Description: Locked out of SSO or password? Set to 1, fix Settings, then clear it.
